results.question: 2025 年各品类的销售额和毛利率分别是多少？（毛利率 =（销售额 - 成本）/ 销售额 × 100，返回三列：品类、销售额、毛利率）
results.generated_sql:
SELECT
    p.category AS 品类,
    SUM(oi.item_amount) AS 销售额,
    (SUM(oi.item_amount) - SUM(p.cost * oi.quantity)) / SUM(oi.item_amount) * 100 AS 毛利率
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.status IN ('已支付', '已发货', '已完成')
  AND o.order_time >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY 销售额 DESC

results.question: 2025 年各省份的销售额和下单用户数分别是多少？（返回三列：省份、销售额、下单用户数，忽略省份为空的用户）
results.generated_sql:
SELECT
    u.province AS 省份,
    SUM(o.pay_amount) AS 销售额,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id) AS 下单用户数
FROM orders o
JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.user_id
WHERE o.status IN ('已支付', '已发货', '已完成')
  AND o.order_time >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
  AND u.province IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY u.province
ORDER BY 销售额 DESC

results.question: 2025 年各省份的销售额相比 2024 年同比增长了多少？请给出省份、2024 销售额、2025 销售额和增长率（百分比），忽略省份为空的用户。
results.generated_sql:
SELECT
    u.province,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_time >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND o.order_time < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' THEN o.pay_amount ELSE 0 END) AS sales_2024,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_time >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND o.order_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' THEN o.pay_amount ELSE 0 END) AS sales_2025,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_time >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND o.order_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' THEN o.pay_amount ELSE 0 END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_time >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND o.order_time < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' THEN o.pay_amount ELSE 0 END))
    / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_time >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND o.order_time < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' THEN o.pay_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100 AS growth_rate
FROM orders o
JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.user_id
WHERE o.status IN ('已支付', '已发货', '已完成')
  AND u.province IS NOT NULL
  AND o.order_time >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01'
  AND o.order_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY u.province
ORDER BY u.province
